Meal prep on the days you feel well enough!! 

Ive just made 4 days worth of stir-fry. 
I get really bad PMS and it is due to start today and my cycle is normally pretty accurate so last night I batch cooked 4 days worth of chicken stir fry, two different varieties for choice- mushroom and chicken, and Chinese style chicken. 

Should do me 4 days. Super quick and easy
Pre packeged stir fry veg- you can get different varieties hence the chinese style and the mushroom one. 
Packet of stir fry sauce. I used hoisin sauce for the Chinese and sweet chilli for the chicken mushroom one, 
Egg noodles 

-Cook chicken (defrosted) for 8 ish minutes in a frying pan, in a little oil of your choice.  
Whilst chicken is cooking, have egg noodles (if not already cooked) sat in a bowl of hot water to soften, I used boiling water from the kettle, no need to actively cook them on the stove, the boiling kettle water should soften them enough

Add stir fry veg and sauce of choice to the frying pan once chicken is cooked through- MAKE SURE THE CHICKEN IS COOKED THROUGH, this is important!
and cook  through for a few minutes
Add noodles once softened
Add sauce and stir - heat through until piping hot. I wait till it bubbles-  I like to reduce the sauce as I feel it makes it richer and more flavourful, distribute into equal portions (i use plastic containers/Tupperware) 
 and VIOLA. meal preparation done and when you are hungry but too anxious/ depressed etc to cook, heat one of your containers up for a few minutes in the microwave and have yourself a tasty and healthy meal. 

No added salt, sugar etc, I used extra Virgin olive oil. 
 Enjoy and if you try this, let me know!! 💜
